full_judgment: 41. In the light of the facts and circumstances of the case and evidence on record we are of the view that the learned appellate Court committed error in allowing the appeal reversing the judgment of the trial Court: that the plaintiff-petitioner is entitled to a saham of 2.78 acres of land out of 4.48 acres of land and that judgment of the Court of appeal is not a proper judgment of reversal.
